options.reason: The table is a TCGA gene-expression matrix (17852 homogeneous numeric gene features plus metadata) assembled for predicting the PAM50 intrinsic subtype, a five-level nominal outcome with observed counts LumA 499, LumB 197, Basal 171, Her2 78, Normal 36; this is a single categorical target with more than two labels, hence multiclass with PAM50 as the only target. All other columns are expression values usable as features; sample_id is a row key only. No duration or event columns exist, and no static group or chronological ordering column is present, so partitions are simple held-out TCGA splits with a one-shot external CPTAC evaluation (not represented in this schema).
options.title: multiclass
